title: The Patient Mind
summary: Excellent for students. It got me through my finals. — a grateful examinee

pages.text: Imagine a room {~you know well~} and set each fact {~on a shelf in it~}. Walk the room before you sleep, {~and again on waking~}.
Write the thing once in this ink {~and say it as you write~}. You will not need to write it twice.
For the examination hall: a sprig {~in the pocket~}, {~a breath held for the count of seven~}. What you knew {~comes when called~}.
{~To take back what was learned~}, speak the subject's name {~into running water~}, then {~the thing itself~}. It does not come back. {~Never on oneself.~}
pages.authorNote: Outlier. Legible: "speak the subject's name ... then ... It does not come back." Jory's temptation.

pages.text: For names forgotten at the door. Touch the lintel {~with a chalked thumb~} and the name comes.
